envelope.description: Give the workflow state store an entry meta, listStates and a meta-carrying encodeState

body.title: Give the workflow state store an entry meta, listStates and a meta-carrying encodeState
body.summary: Extend src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/state-store.ts so each entry can carry meta { owner, upstream } beside payload, createdAt and touchedAt, with saveState taking the meta, replaceState carrying the previous entry's meta, and a listStates that returns entries newest first without touching expiry. encodeState takes the optional meta and reencodeState preserves it; the payload shape and token format do not change.
acceptanceChecks: encodeState stores meta beside the payload and reencodeState and replaceState carry it onto the replacement
listStates returns every live entry newest-touch first and does not change any entry's expiry
An entry saved without meta behaves exactly as before and has no owner

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/__tests__/state-store-meta.test.ts: the state store keeps meta beside the payload, carries it through reencodeState and replaceState, lists entries newest first without touching expiry, and an entry saved without meta behaves as before
